The method is `MockLocation.__fspath__` in `tests/test_aids.py:21-22`. It returns `self.path`, which is the value that was passed to the constructor (`__init__(self, path)`, line 18-19).

`MockLocation` is the test helper that stands in for `pathlib.Path` objects. Its docstring cites PEP 519, the `os.PathLike` protocol. When `os.fspath()` is called on a `MockLocation` instance, it calls `__fspath__`. The result is the stored path, returned as is. There is no conversion or normalization, so the return type is whatever was given at construction, normally a `str`.

I only read the `__fspath__` and `__init__` lines and the start of the docstring. I didn't check how the tests construct `MockLocation`, so the `str` is an assumption.
